title: BoundedLearnerCoordinator001 subordinate flows
purpose: Exact human-assisted local cycle through proposal, not self-deployment

shared_primitives.REQUIRE: Abort the current flow immediately with the supplied typed non-success outcome unless the predicate is true.
shared_primitives.RESOLVE: Resolve an exact immutable reference; never guess a missing artifact.
shared_primitives.QUALIFIED: Check claim/profile/transition against bound qualification evidence.
shared_primitives.AUTHORIZE: Request scoped authorization from Nexus; no implicit authority carry-forward.
shared_primitives.PIN: Bind state to an exact ECID/configuration identity.
shared_primitives.BUDGET: Reserve/release bounded compute, context, or refinement budget.
shared_primitives.ATOMIC_PUBLISH: Stage fully, then atomically publish or preserve prior valid state.
shared_primitives.REPLAY_SAFE: Check durable action evidence; unresolved effects block replay. Reconciliation is explicit, never a hidden automatic retry.
shared_primitives.REHYDRATE: Load only the externally referenced context required for the current step.
shared_primitives.COMPACT: Produce minimal carry-forward state while preserving required dependencies.
shared_primitives.RESULT: Return typed success or typed non-success outcome.
shared_primitives.AUDIT: Append immutable/auditable decision or lifecycle evidence.
shared_primitives.IDEMPOTENT_EXECUTE: Execute side effect under idempotency key and durable commit semantics.
shared_primitives.TRY: Unwrap a typed result only on SUCCESS; propagate its non-success code unchanged. Helper failures are implicit exits from every process node.

global_rules: Compress implementation, not contract meaning: factor repeated guards into shared primitives only after behavior is test-covered.
Every terminal path returns a typed outcome.
Every production mutation is staged and atomically published or leaves the prior valid state intact.
Every side effect is separated from replayable computation and has idempotency/reconciliation semantics.
No subsystem reaches into another subsystem internals; use versioned typed public contracts.
Research mechanisms (HSA/MSA, recurrent depth, DARP, directional-guidance implementations) are independently qualified and are not prerequisites for proving overlay composition.
Core-only execution remains mandatory for each Core generation.
Terminal maps contain allowed outcome sets. Grouped failure exits preserve the actual error code; they do not translate every failure into one generic status.
Every helper failure implicitly exits through the declared failure envelope. Graphs are summaries, not exhaustive executable programs. TRY and REQUIRE are fail-fast.
All loops consume finite budgets and have stalled/no-progress exits. Graph reachability alone does not prove termination.
Canonical describes design authority, not implementation. The implementation field states the available simulator coverage.
Forbidden-edge statements are reviewed architectural constraints; the graph validator does not inspect runtime imports/calls or enforce these prose rules.
